context: Ancient street signs and crafting materials; Anselm, Beatrix and Carmine begin a ritual while party defends them. E4550-E4559 and E4640-E4649 reviewed.
decisions: Imported Araha'wi rows preserved. Signs retain glossary spellings. Three casters confirmed at E4629. Cross-row clauses retain boundaries.
provenance: Eleven exact-match imported rows preserved; 69 new English translations from Japanese source with adjacent context reviewed.

translations.en: Something like a rotting sign lay on the ground.
The letters were faded and difficult to read,
but they appeared to say "Kulgar Straat."
There was something like an ancient signpost.
It was decaying and difficult to read,
but it appeared to say "Dulong Straat."
Could it be an old sign of some sort?
Something was nailed to the wall.
It was badly rusted and difficult to read,
but it appeared to say "Kayuken."
Something like letters was carved into the wall.
They were weathered and difficult to read,
but they appeared to say "Skua."
An old stone tablet lay at your feet.
It appeared to be a sign of some sort.
It was dirty, but a gentle wipe
revealed the word "Kaipers."
In a corner lay a mineral, gleaming faintly in the light.
It was slightly chipped, but that should be no problem.
You obtained a @3rCrystal Fragment@0r.
You put the @3rCrystal Fragment@0r at the bottom of your bag.
It had some weight to it, but you could manage.
You now had all the materials.
You should return to @7rCarmine@0r.
A hard stone lay at your feet.
Its glossy surface shone brightly enough to reflect your face.
It seemed so hard that even a sword could not scratch it.
You obtained @3rSteel@0r.
You put the @3rSteel@0r at the bottom of your bag.
It was very heavy, but not enough to hinder your movements.
An ore glowed faintly red in a crack in the wall.
It was slightly warm to the touch.
You obtained @3rFire Ore@0r.
You put the @3rFire Ore@0r at the bottom of your bag.
Something like a plant was growing there.
Looking closely, you saw what seemed to be a branch shining gold.
You obtained a @3rGolden Branch@0r.
Taking care not to snap it, you gently placed the @3rGolden Branch@0r
in your bag.
It was an eerie door.
At first glance, it looked like an ordinary gate found anywhere.
But the air spilling from it was like a sinister aura,
spreading something unnatural into its surroundings.
Could this be the gate to the other realm?
This is the otherworldly gate.
It is just as my master, @7rChu Lu Gah@0r, once described it.
It is said that @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r itself was originally
one of the devices built to seal this gate.
Thus, the same materials used in @6rGraham Labyrinth@0r
are said to have been used to make the gate.
Now, let us begin the ritual.
Please protect us until it is complete.
Holding the magic-circle activation texts that @7rAnselm@0r had given them,
@7rBeatrix@0r and @7rCarmine@0r began chanting.
Then, perhaps drawn by the words of the chant,
monsters appeared from every direction.
You could not let this ritual be interrupted.
You readied your weapons and prepared for battle.
The three were still chanting to activate the magic circle.
Perhaps their chant drew the monsters:
one after another appeared and attacked, giving you no time to breathe.
They've come...
They've come! They're here!
What had come?
At those words, you looked up
and saw familiar, sinister figures before you.
Hee hee hee hee hee hee hee!
It's been a while! I've waited for this day
down in the depths of hell!
a Sorcerer's magic takes effect with tremendous power.
